name: libinput
description: Input device handling library abstracting evdev devices (keyboards, mice, touchpads, touchscreens, tablets) behind a common event API, including pointer acceleration and gesture recognition. Used by Wayland compositors (via wlroots) and X.Org.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
